title.en: Silent Movie Mondays - Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde

ai.en: Silent Movie Mondays shows Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde (1920) at the Orpheum Theatre, with live organ accompaniment. A jazz band plays before the film, and a discussion on silent-era special effects follows.

events.description: Vancouver Civic Theatres presents Silent Movie Mondays, featuring classic silent films with live accompaniment on the historic Wurlitzer organ the last theatre organ in Canada still performing in its original home. Enjoy a pre-show performance by the Gatsby Strutters Jazz Band, followed by the film with organist Edward Norman. Afterward, Keith Blackmore of Vancouver Film School will lead a discussion on silent-era special effects with a special guest. Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde (1920) stars John Barrymore as a respected doctor who develops a potion intended to separate the good and evil sides of human nature. His experiment releases the cruel Mr. Hyde, an alter ego who becomes increasingly difficult to control, with tragic consequences. An especially remarkable feature of the silent film is Barrymore s first transformation into Hyde, which he performed largely by contorting his face and body rather than relying on makeup or camera effects.

title.en: Silent Movie Mondays - Charlie Chaplin Shorts

ai.en: Silent Movie Mondays shows Charlie Chaplin shorts at the Orpheum Theatre, with a live Wurlitzer organ. A jazz band plays before the films, and a discussion on silent-era special effects follows.

events.description: Vancouver Civic Theatres presents Silent Movie Mondays, featuring classic silent films with live accompaniment on the historic Wurlitzer organ the last theatre organ in Canada still performing in its original home. Enjoy a pre-show performance by the Gatsby Strutters Jazz Band, followed by the film with organists Michael Dirk and Koos Van Nieuwkoop. Afterward, Keith Blackmore of Vancouver Film School will lead a discussion on silent-era special effects with a special guest. Three of Charlie Chaplin s most beloved shorts showcase his gift for physical comedy and comic mischief. In The Cure, Charlie causes chaos at a health spa when his hidden supply of alcohol finds its way into the mineral waters. The Champion follows an unlikely boxer who relies on clever tricks to survive in the ring, while The Adventurer sees Chaplin as an escaped convict attempting to blend into high society while staying one step ahead of the police.
